full_judgment:
Mohammad Anwarul Haque J.:- This Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal is directed Against the judgment and order dated 02.06.2010 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Misc. Case No. 7796 of 2008 filed under section 561A of the Criminal Procedure for quashment of the C.R. Case No. 1218 of 2007 pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Satkhira where the High Court Division has discharged the Rule with an observation that there is no ground for quashment of the criminal proceeding of C.R Case No. 1218 of 2007 pending before the said court. 

 2. In short, the case for the respondent-complainant is as follows: 

 5. On hearing the High Court Division has made an observation that though the allegation for recovery of loan amount comes within the scope of civil suit there is no bar to instituting a criminal proceeding to secure the punishment under the Penal Code. Both the civil and criminal cases can run together independently. 

 6. Mr. Chowdhury Md. Zahangir, Advocate-on-record submits that High Court Division has committed an error discharging the Rule because the allegation brought in the complaint-petition exclusively comes within the mischief of civil court and there can be no scope to bring the matter within the purview of the criminal court. Moreover, the relationship between the complainant and the accused being fiduciary the transaction by way of loan does not come within the scope of criminal breach of trust punishable under section 406 of the Penal Code. However, there are several litigations between the parties; as such it is merely an abuse of the process of the court for which the proceeding should he quashed.
